Name: Days
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Days, command: many)
SELECT id, date(created_at, 'unixepoch') AS day, datetime(created_at, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS local_time,
       strftime('%Y-%m', created_at, 'unixepoch') AS month, julianday(created_at, 'unixepoch') AS julian_day,
       unixepoch(julian) AS from_julian, time(julian) AS clock
FROM events;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:date(created_at, 'unixepoch')⟩ AS day, ⟨c2 aliased:datetime(created_at, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')⟩ AS local_time,
       ⟨c3 aliased:strftime('%Y-%m', created_at, 'unixepoch')⟩ AS month, ⟨c4 aliased:julianday(created_at, 'unixepoch')⟩ AS julian_day,
       ⟨c5 aliased:unixepoch(julian)⟩ AS from_julian, ⟨c6 aliased:time(julian)⟩ AS clock
FROM events;

Name: Flags
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:if(flag, 'on', 'off')⟩ AS state, ⟨c1 aliased:iif(flag, label)⟩ AS shown, ⟨c2 aliased:if(flag = 1, 'one', flag = 2, 'two', 'many')⟩ AS count_word\nFROM events;

Name: Curves
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Curves, command: one)
SELECT tanh(julian) AS squashed, cosh(julian) AS hyperbolic, unistr(label) AS decoded FROM events WHERE id = ?;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:tanh(julian)⟩ AS squashed, ⟨c1 aliased:cosh(julian)⟩ AS hyperbolic, ⟨c2 aliased:unistr(label)⟩ AS decoded FROM events WHERE id = ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩
